run_benchmark_save_load: run a benchmark that saves and loads a PyTorch tensor 1000 times using torch.save and torch.load
create_tensor_save: create a random PyTorch tensor and save it to disk using torch.save
test_tensor_load: test loading a saved PyTorch tensor from disk using torch.load
refactor_benchmark_timing: refactor the benchmark script to measure torch.save and torch.load timing with configurable iterations
summarize_benchmark: summarize the torch.save and torch.load benchmark script that measures serialization performance
